zones.what: These decks sit directly above the lifeboat line; lifeboats block the lower portion of the view while the horizon and sky remain visible.
zones.effect: Ocean view and balcony cabins see boats instead of water when looking straight down or at a downward angle, though distant views are unobstructed.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to guests who want unobstructed water views at all angles; irrelevant to those focused on horizon views or interior cabins.

zones.what: Deck 15 Central Park overhead creates a neighborhood open to sky but shaded by overhangs and surrounded by rising deck structures.
zones.effect: Central Park Balcony cabins on Deck 14 mid open onto a living-plant park rather than open ocean; quieter and shaded but with no ocean horizon.
zones.mattersTo: Matters greatly to those expecting traditional ocean balconies; appeals to guests seeking unique, park-like outdoor space.

zones.what: The Boardwalk with AquaTheater on Deck 15/16 is directly overhead; open-air venue with performances, crowds, and activity until late evening.
zones.effect: Boardwalk Balcony cabins on Deck 14 aft open onto a neighborhood amphitheater environment with performance noise and foot traffic overhead.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to guests seeking quiet oceanfront balconies; appeals to those wanting entertainment-district energy and AquaTheater access.

zones.what: Central Park on Deck 15 is directly overhead (3-4 decks above); outdoor walking neighborhood with restaurants and foot traffic until late.
zones.effect: Limited noise transmission due to distance and open-air design; occasional voices or live music may reach upper balconies during events.
zones.mattersTo: Minor consideration for light sleepers on Deck 12; generally irrelevant on Deck 11 and below.

zones.what: The Boardwalk and AquaTheater on Deck 15/16 are 3-7 decks overhead; open-air performance venue with evening shows and ambient crowd noise.
zones.effect: Boardwalk Balcony cabins on these decks open inward to the Boardwalk canyon; occasional performance audio and crowd sounds filter down, especially Decks 11-12.
zones.mattersTo: Matters for guests expecting traditional quiet balconies; appeals to those wanting Boardwalk immersion and easy AquaTheater access.

zones.what: Deck 17 Grand Suites are directly below; Deck 16 public venues (pools, buffet, Suite Lounge) are two decks down.
zones.effect: Top-deck location ensures no foot traffic or venue noise from above; pool deck activity two decks below is typically inaudible inside suites.
zones.mattersTo: Premium benefit for suite guests; the absence of overhead activity enhances privacy and quiet.

zones.what: Main pool decks, Windjammer buffet, and Solarium on Deck 15/16 are directly below, with heavy daytime foot traffic, dining service, and pool activity.
zones.effect: Cabins on Deck 14 may experience muffled noise from deck furniture moving, crowds, or buffet service during the day; Deck 17 is insulated by one deck.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to daytime nappers and those sensitive to activity vibrations on Deck 14; less relevant on Deck 17 where distance mutes most impact.

zones.what: Royal Theater main showroom on Decks 3-5 is below forward sections; evening performances with amplified audio and subwoofers.
zones.effect: Cabins in forward sections may detect low-frequency audio or vibration during shows, typically 7-10 PM; structure transmits bass better than voices.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to guests in early-to-bed routines or sensitive to vibration; irrelevant to those out for evening activities.

zones.what: Elevator banks run forward, midship, and aft on all cabin decks; midship banks serve Central Park/Boardwalk neighborhoods with high traffic.
zones.effect: Cabins immediately adjacent to elevator lobbies experience door chimes, conversation, and foot traffic at all hours; convenience trades against lobby noise.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to light sleepers who should avoid elevator-adjacent cabins; appeals to mobility-limited guests prioritizing short walks.

zones.what: Deck 3 is the lowest guest cabin deck and sits near crew access routes; service corridors run through this deck with crew foot traffic.
zones.effect: Cabins on Deck 3 may be near crew stairs or service doors with periodic activity during early morning and late-night crew changes.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to guests sensitive to hallway traffic noise; generally minor due to good soundproofing but more noticeable than higher decks.

zones.what: Aft cabins on lower decks are closer to propulsion machinery spaces; low-frequency vibration and hum may be present, especially at cruising speed.
zones.effect: Aft cabins on Deck 3 are most susceptible to engine vibration; Decks 6-7 aft are higher and experience less, but some guests may still detect a hum.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to vibration-sensitive sleepers and those bothered by white noise; irrelevant to guests who find engine hum soothing or don't notice it.

zones.what: Bow thrusters in the forward hull activate during docking maneuvers; produces brief, loud mechanical grinding transmitted through the hull structure.
zones.effect: Forward cabins on lower decks hear and feel thruster activation during port arrivals and departures, typically early morning; lasts 5-15 minutes.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to guests who value undisturbed sleep on port mornings; irrelevant to early risers or those eager to watch docking.

zones.what: Anchor chain locker is in the bow below forward cabins; anchor deployment creates loud metallic rattling through hull structure each port arrival.
zones.effect: Forward cabins on lower decks experience anchor chain noise on port mornings, typically 6-8 AM; brief (2-5 minutes) but very loud and impossible to sleep through.
zones.mattersTo: Matters significantly to guests prioritizing sleep on port days; irrelevant to early risers planning to be awake for arrivals.

zones.what: Oasis-class ships have balconies cantilevered beyond the hull line on these decks in forward and aft sections, creating deeper balcony spaces.
zones.effect: Select ocean-view balconies on Decks 11-12 forward and aft have extra-deep balconies extending past neighbors above and below, offering more privacy and space.
zones.mattersTo: Appeals to guests seeking larger private outdoor space; premium benefit for balcony users who entertain or lounge outside.

zones.what: Promenade View Interior cabins have windows overlooking the Royal Promenade, an interior boulevard with shops, bars, and parades.
zones.effect: These cabins have interior views of an active indoor street with activity until midnight or later; parade noise and people-watching replace ocean views.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to guests expecting quiet or dark interior cabins; appeals to those wanting entertainment-district energy and human activity views.

zones.what: Central Park Balcony cabins overlook an open-air park with living plants on Deck 15, not the ocean; lined with restaurants and foot traffic until late.
zones.effect: Balconies open to a unique park neighborhood with greenery and ambient restaurant/pedestrian activity; no ocean views but distinctive outdoor environment.
zones.mattersTo: Matters greatly to those expecting ocean balconies; highly appealing to guests seeking unique, urban-garden ambiance instead of traditional sea views.

zones.what: Boardwalk Balcony cabins overlook the Boardwalk neighborhood on Deck 15, an open-air entertainment district with carousel, AquaTheater, and dining.
zones.effect: Balconies open inward to a neighborhood amphitheater with performances, crowds, and activity; no ocean views but immersive entertainment-district experience.
zones.mattersTo: Matters greatly to those expecting ocean balconies; highly appealing to guests with kids or those seeking high-energy, entertainment-focused environment.

zones.what: Boardwalk and Park View interior cabins have windows overlooking either the Boardwalk or Central Park neighborhoods, not the ocean or traditional interior corridors.
zones.effect: Interior cabins with natural light and views of active outdoor neighborhoods; ambient activity noise and people-watching replace typical interior cabin darkness.
zones.mattersTo: Appeals to guests seeking interior pricing with windowed views and natural light; matters to those expecting quiet, dark interior cabins.
